grass-flow.purpose: Swept straw/olive blades tie many growing points into a broad low living mat.

grass-islands.purpose: Interrupted low grass hummocks form irregular dry holes between colonies.

sage-fan.purpose: Woody horizontal branching shrub, grey-olive paddle leaves and asymmetric sheltered crown.

red-brush.purpose: Tough recurved clustered leaves with swollen woody joints and a few red active tips.

erosion-join.purpose: Small fractured shale fans seat native shallow-cut edges without inventing collision.

release-nodule.purpose: Irregular swollen mineral lobes surround dark recessed release pockets; local Red only.

method: Original direct scripted Blender meshes and vertex materials. No image-to-3D, third-party art or reference pixels.
coordinate_system: Metres; Blender Z up, standard glTF Y up.
